in_sanskrit.name: Parvani
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Maiden, Young Girl
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Parvani एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Parvani is a Sanskrit and Hindu name derived from the word 'parvati'. It means 'maiden' or 'young girl'. In Hindu mythology, Parvati is the wife of Lord Shiva and is considered the goddess of love, beauty, fertility, and marriage.
